name: Spelling with Letter Tiles
prompt:
Create a portrait 4:5 English spelling card for the word {{word}}. In the upper two thirds, show {{meaning}} as one simple, original illustration on a plain background. In the lower third, place a single left-to-right row of equal-size letter tiles spelling exactly {{word}}.
Use exactly one lowercase letter per tile, in the supplied order, with generous separation between tiles. Do not omit, repeat, transpose, merge, or decorate letters. Use a plain readable typeface and high contrast. Keep enough margin around the row so no tile is cropped.
Do not print the full word elsewhere or add a title, translation, phonetic symbols, extra letters, or instructions. The visual is intended for spelling practice after a human checks that the tile count and letter sequence match the target; it is not an automatically verified answer key.

Use original, generic subjects, with no logos, branded characters, or imitation of a named artist. Do not add a watermark, decorative writing, or extra labels. Render only the specified text, with clear spacing and high contrast; if it cannot be rendered reliably, leave that text area blank rather than inventing letters. Any generated lettering must be checked before learning or printing.

title_i18n.ja: 文字タイルでつづる単語カード

description: Combine one object illustration with an ordered row of clearly separated letter tiles.

variables.name: word
variables.description: One concrete English word, ideally three to six lowercase letters.

variables.name: meaning
variables.description: A clear visual description of the target word.
